question.knowledge_point: Calculating dy/dx at a Point Using dx/dy
question.worked_solution:
First, we differentiate $x(y)$ with respect to $y:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}x}{\text{d}y} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}y}({y}^{5}+3y-5) \\  & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}y}({y}^{5})+3\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}y}(y)-5\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}y}(1) \\  & =5{y}^{4}+3(1)+0 \\  & =5{y}^{4}+3.\end{aligned}
$$

Now, taking the reciprocal of $\frac{\text{d}x}{\text{d}y},$ we get

$$
\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}={(\frac{\text{d}x}{\text{d}y})}^{-1}=\frac{1}{5{y}^{4}+3}.
$$

Finally, substituting the point $(33,2),$ we find

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}{|}_{(x,y)=(33,2)} & =\frac{1}{5\cdot {2}^{4}+3}=\frac{1}{83}.\end{aligned}
$$
